options.content:
## Threats: which assets to fix first?
Snapshot **${snapshot:text}**, compared with **${compare:text}** — clients: ${tenant:text}. Counted in **exposures**: one vulnerability (CVE) on one asset.

panels.title: Exposures
panels.description: Findings (asset × CVE) of the snapshot. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Assets concerned
panels.description: Assets with at least one finding. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(DISTINCT f.asset) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: KEV exposures
panels.description: Findings of a CVE in CISA KEV. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.kev) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: ACT exposures
panels.description: Findings to fix now. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Assets with ACT
panels.description: Assets carrying a finding to fix now. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(DISTINCT f.asset) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Overdue
panels.description: ACT and ATTEND findings past their BOD 26-04 due date on the snapshot day. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND f.due_date < s.snap_day) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Fix available
panels.description: Share of findings for which a fixed version or a patch is known. Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, round(100.0 * count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.fix_available) / NULLIF(count(f.finding_id), 0), 1) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: EPSS ≥ 10 %
panels.description: Findings of a CVE with an exploitation probability of 10 % or more (EPSS, 30 days). Arrow: change since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT s.snap_day::timestamptz AS time, count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.epss >= 0.1) AS value
FROM snap s LEFT JOIN f ON f.ord = s.ord
WHERE s.snap_day IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.ord, s.snap_day ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: SSVC decision × severity — exposures
panels.description: Findings of the snapshot per decision and CVSS rating.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "SSVC decision",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical') AS "Critical",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'High') AS "High",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Medium') AS "Medium",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Low') AS "Low",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Unknown') AS "Unknown"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN f ON f.level = l.level AND f.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: … of which known exploited (KEV)
panels.description: The same findings, limited to CVEs listed in CISA KEV.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT l.level AS "SSVC decision",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical' AND f.kev) AS "Critical",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'High' AND f.kev) AS "High",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Medium' AND f.kev) AS "Medium",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Low' AND f.kev) AS "Low",
  count(f.finding_id) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Unknown' AND f.kev) AS "Unknown"
FROM (VALUES ('ACT', 1), ('ATTEND', 2), ('TRACK', 3)) l (level, o)
LEFT JOIN f ON f.level = l.level AND f.ord = 2
WHERE l.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY l.level, l.o ORDER BY l.o

panels.title: Assets to fix first
panels.description: Assets of the snapshot, most urgent first: findings to fix now, known exploited, overdue. ACT change: since the compared snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (1, NULLIF('${compare}', '')::date), (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
,
cur AS (SELECT f.asset, min(f.asset_name) AS name, min(f.tenant_name) AS client,
  min(f.zone) AS zone, min(f.exposure) AS exposure,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS act, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ATTEND') AS attend,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'TRACK') AS track, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.kev) AS kev,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level IN ('ACT', 'ATTEND') AND f.due_date < f.snap_day) AS overdue,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.severity = 'Critical') AS critical, max(f.epss) AS epss,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.fix_available) AS fixable
  FROM f WHERE f.ord = 2 GROUP BY f.asset),
prev AS (SELECT f.asset, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS act FROM f WHERE f.ord = 1 GROUP BY f.asset)
SELECT cur.name AS "Asset", cur.client AS "Client", cur.zone AS "Zone", cur.exposure AS "Exposure",
  cur.act AS "ACT", cur.attend AS "ATTEND", cur.track AS "TRACK", cur.kev AS "KEV",
  cur.overdue AS "Overdue", cur.critical AS "Critical", round(cur.epss::numeric, 3) AS "Max EPSS",
  cur.fixable AS "With a fix",
  CASE WHEN NULLIF('${compare}', '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE cur.act - coalesce(prev.act, 0) END AS "ACT change"
FROM cur LEFT JOIN prev USING (asset)
ORDER BY cur.act DESC, cur.kev DESC, cur.overdue DESC, cur.critical DESC, cur.attend DESC, cur.name
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Exposures per decision, day after day
panels.description: Each day: the findings of each client's latest run that day (dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT x.day::timestamptz AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tenant, generated_at::date) run_id FROM a2vm.runs
  WHERE tenant = ANY (ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(generated_at)
  ORDER BY tenant, generated_at::date, generated_at DESC) r
JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring})
GROUP BY x.day ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Exposures per zone and exposure
panels.description: Findings of the snapshot per zone (client label) and SSVC system exposure.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snap (ord, snap_day) AS (VALUES (2, '${snapshot}'::date)),
f AS (SELECT s.ord, s.snap_day, x.* FROM snap s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL a2vm.snapshot_runs(ARRAY[${tenant:sqlstring}]::text[], s.snap_day) r
  JOIN a2vm.decision_facts x ON x.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE x.sources && ARRAY[${scanner:sqlstring}]::text[] AND x.kev_label IN (${kev:sqlstring}) AND x.severity IN (${severity:sqlstring}) AND x.epss_band IN (${epss:sqlstring}) AND x.product_type IN (${ptype:sqlstring}) AND x.level IN (${decision:sqlstring}))
SELECT coalesce(nullif(f.zone, ''), 'no zone') || ' · ' || coalesce(f.exposure, '?') AS "Zone · exposure",
count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') AS "ACT", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ATTEND') AS "ATTEND", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'TRACK') AS "TRACK"
FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.level = 'ACT') DESC, count(*) DESC LIMIT 20
